humanReview.verdict: rejected — agent self-scores were inflated; every category re-scored from the board against the turnaround

frontProfileSilhouette.label: front/profile silhouette
frontProfileSilhouette.note: Human review: body detail falls well short of the turnaround — no V-neck placket or buttons, no belt, sleeve stripes reduced to shoulder patches, legs read as stacked capsule segments with visible seam rings, and the profile shows an open sleeve-cuff interior.

headBodyProportions.label: head/body proportions
headBodyProportions.note: Human review: the front head reads as a tall egg with an oversized bare forehead; the turnaround's wider head with a low hairline is not matched.

hairMass.label: hair mass
hairMass.note: Human review: the hairline sits behind the headband so the front view reads bald above the brows; the ponytail is faceted with a hard ridge, not the art's smooth tapered sweep.

clothingConstruction.label: clothing construction
clothingConstruction.note: Human review: jersey lacks the concept's V-neck trim, placket buttons and triple sleeve stripes; pants lack the below-knee cuff into long red socks; the hip band reads as separate shorts.

faceExpressionRead.label: face/expression read
faceExpressionRead.note: Human review: brows too thin, eyes too small and sclera-forward versus the concept's large dark eyes; the determined frown is not readable; the headband should cross the mid-forehead with slicked hair visible above it.

heroAndFieldScale.label: hero + 40px read
